events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html` channel pills and preset chips are `<span>`s with click handlers (`public/sportscaster.js`), unreachable by keyboard. `#ai-api-key` and `#ai-model` have no labels, and the key field is `type="text"` while the GitHub token field is `type="password"`.

## What to do

1. Turn the spans into `<button type="button" aria-pressed>` (keep the classes) and toggle `aria-pressed` in the handlers.
2. Add labels; make the key field `type="password" autocomplete="off"`.
3. Use `role="group" aria-labelledby` for chip groups.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Tab and Enter/Space switch channels and filters
- [ ] Every input has an accessible name
- [ ] Selected state announced

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory blt-gitcaster/public
```
